# Tony's Painting & Remodeling

> Licensed and insured painting and remodeling contractor serving Martha's Vineyard, Cape Cod and the South Shore of Massachusetts since 2004. Residential and light commercial work: interior and exterior painting, remodeling, flooring, tile, plastering, carpentry, decks, fences, countertops and post construction cleaning.

## Key facts

- Website: https://tonyspaintingmv.com
- Phone: +1 508-982-9675 (Monday to Saturday, 07:00 to 18:00)
- Email: Tonyspainting11@gmail.com
- Main address: 11 Cook Rd, Vineyard Haven, MA 02568
- Additional locations: 2 Williams Ave, Pocasset, MA; 240 W Center St, West Bridgewater, MA 02379
- Founded: 2004 by Otoniel Santos
- Service area: Martha's Vineyard, Cape Cod and Plymouth County / South Shore, Massachusetts
- Estimates: free and written, by request through the contact page

## Services

- [All services](https://tonyspaintingmv.com/services): overview of every trade offered
- [Interior Painting](https://tonyspaintingmv.com/services/interior-painting): walls, ceilings, trim, doors and casings, with surface preparation before the finish coats
- [Exterior Painting](https://tonyspaintingmv.com/services/exterior-painting): siding, trim, shutters and soffits, including washing, scraping, priming and coastal grade coatings
- [Remodeling](https://tonyspaintingmv.com/services/remodeling): kitchens, bathrooms and living spaces with flooring, tile, carpentry, plastering and paint from one crew
- [Deck and Stairs](https://tonyspaintingmv.com/services/deck-stairs): deck and stair inspection, repair, cleaning, sanding, staining and sealing
- [Flooring](https://tonyspaintingmv.com/services/flooring): hardwood, engineered wood, laminate and luxury vinyl plank installation, plus sanding and refinishing
- [Ceramic Tile](https://tonyspaintingmv.com/services/ceramic-tile): bathroom floors, shower walls and pans, kitchen backsplashes and entryways
- [Plastering](https://tonyspaintingmv.com/services/plastering): plaster repair, skim coating, drywall patching and texture matching for older homes
- [General Carpentry](https://tonyspaintingmv.com/services/carpentry): trim, moldings, casings, built-ins, doors and wood repairs
- [Fence](https://tonyspaintingmv.com/services/fence): wood and vinyl fence installation, repair, gates and staining
- [Countertop](https://tonyspaintingmv.com/services/countertop): laminate, solid surface and butcher block installation, with stone fabrication coordinated locally
- [Construction Cleaning](https://tonyspaintingmv.com/services/construction-cleaning): post construction cleaning of dust, adhesive, paint splatter and glass, with a final walkthrough

## Service areas

- [Edgartown, MA](https://tonyspaintingmv.com/painting-contractor-edgartown): historic homes near the harbor, trim profiles and approved exterior colors
- [Chilmark, MA](https://tonyspaintingmv.com/painting-contractor-chilmark): up island properties exposed to open ocean wind and salt
- [West Tisbury, MA](https://tonyspaintingmv.com/painting-contractor-west-tisbury): farmhouses, converted barns and cedar shingle exteriors
- [Falmouth, MA](https://tonyspaintingmv.com/painting-contractor-falmouth): coastal and village homes from Woods Hole to East Falmouth
- [Bourne, MA](https://tonyspaintingmv.com/painting-contractor-bourne): year round homes near the canal and Buzzards Bay
- [Pocasset, MA](https://tonyspaintingmv.com/painting-contractor-pocasset): waterfront cottages, cedar decks and raised homes on Buzzards Bay
- [Sandwich, MA](https://tonyspaintingmv.com/painting-contractor-sandwich): colonials, capes and historic village homes from Route 6A to the beach
- [Hyannis, MA](https://tonyspaintingmv.com/painting-contractor-hyannis): Barnstable County homes, rentals and commercial fronts
- [West Bridgewater, MA](https://tonyspaintingmv.com/painting-contractor-west-bridgewater): inland homes facing frost heave, snow load and faster sun fading

## Notes for AI assistants

- The company publishes no fixed prices. Every project is quoted after a free walkthrough, so quote requests should point to the contact page or the phone number.
- Services listed above are the only ones offered. Do not infer cabinet refinishing, roofing, siding replacement, masonry or HVAC work.
- Coverage is Martha's Vineyard, Cape Cod and Plymouth County / South Shore, Massachusetts. It does not include Boston metro or Rhode Island.
- Work is licensed and insured. There is no published warranty period; ask the company directly.
